supporting_ids: s2:Nuclear Pasta in Cold Non-Accreting Neutron Stars: Symmetry Energy Effects
rationale: The papers 2309.01591, s2:Nuclear Pasta in Cold Non-Accreting Neutron Stars: Symmetry Energy Effects, and 2505.18309 investigate the effects of energy functionals and symmetry energy on the properties of pasta phases in neutron stars, contributing substantive new evidence but not fully resolving the question.
